description:
As a FlashGuard user
  I want transfers to sanctioned recipients to be rejected
  So that compliance and database integrity are maintained

steps.name: the FlashGuard web application is available
the backend API is available
the database connection is available
the user logs in via the Web UI
the Web Dashboard should be displayed
the authentication API request should succeed
a sanctioned test recipient exists
the compliance test opening balances are recorded
the transaction and ledger baselines are recorded
the compliance audit baseline is recorded
the user selects the transfer option
the user selects the sanctioned recipient
the user enters a transfer amount of "100.00"
the user attempts the sanctioned transfer
